title: Existing podcast_schedules table skips missing index creation
reasoning: Revision 020 returns as soon as podcast_schedules exists, so it never verifies ix_podcast_schedules_user_id. If a prior partial run or precreated table lacks the index, rerunning the migration stamps success while leaving user-scoped schedule queries without the intended index.
reproduction: Create podcast_schedules manually without ix_podcast_schedules_user_id, set the database to revision 019, then run revision 020. The migration returns before CREATE INDEX and the index remains missing.
recommendation: Separate table and index idempotency: create the table only when absent, then independently check sqlite_master for ix_podcast_schedules_user_id and create it when missing.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature includes no migration tests, and the existing schedule CRUD tests validate API behavior on a freshly created test schema rather than rerunning 020 against a partially initialized schema.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a migration test where podcast_schedules already exists without ix_podcast_schedules_user_id before applying 020, then assert the index exists after upgrade.
minimumFixScope: Update alembic/versions/020_add_podcast_schedules.py to make index creation independently idempotent.
